import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX = 210;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;

    static int[][] cap = new int[MAX*MAX*2+10][MAX*MAX*2+10];
    static int[][] flow = new int[MAX*MAX*2+10][MAX*MAX*2+10];
    static int[] h = new int[MAX*MAX*2+10];
    static int[] vh = new int[MAX*MAX*2+10];
    static int n, t, src, dst;

    static int idx(int i, int j) { return (i-1)*n + j; }
    static boolean valid(int x, int y) { return x>=1 && x<=n && y>=1 && y<=n; }

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int c) {
        cap[u][v] += c;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int lim) {
        if (u == dst) return lim;
        int pushed = lim, delta, minH = n;
        for (int v = 0; v < n*n*2+2; ++v) {
            if (cap[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0) {
                if (h[u] == h[v] + 1) {
                    delta = dfs(v, Math.min(pushed, cap[u][v] - flow[u][v]));
                    flow[u][v] += delta;
                    flow[v][u] -= delta;
                    pushed -= delta;
                    if (h[src] == n || pushed == 0) return lim - pushed;
                }
                minH = Math.min(minH, h[v] + 1);
            }
        }
        if (pushed == lim) {
            vh[h[u]]--;
            vh[minH]++;
            if (vh[h[u]] == 0) h[src] = n;
            h[u] = minH;
        }
        return lim - pushed;
    }

    static int max_flow() {
        if (src == dst) return INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX*MAX*2+10; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(flow[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(cap[i], 0);
        }
        Arrays.fill(h, 0);
        Arrays.fill(vh, 0);
        int res = 0;
        while (h[src] != n*n*2+2) {
            res += dfs(src, INF);
        }
        return res;
    }

    static class Node {
        int x, y, d;
        Node(int x, int y, int d) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.d = d;
        }
    }

    static int[][] dist1 = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] vis = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] g1 = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] g2 = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int sx, sy;
    static final int[] dx = {0,0,-1,1};
    static final int[] dy = {-1,1,0,0};

    static void bfs1() {
        Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Node cur = new Node(sx, sy, 0);
        q.add(cur);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dist1[i], 0x7f7f7f7f);
            Arrays.fill(vis[i], 0);
        }
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            cur = q.poll();
            dist1[cur.x][cur.y] = cur.d;
            if (cur.d > t) break;
            for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
                int nx = cur.x+dx[k], ny = cur.y+dy[k];
                if (valid(nx,ny) && g1[nx][ny]!='Y' && vis[nx][ny]==0) {
                    Node nxt = new Node(nx, ny, cur.d+1);
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    q.add(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void bfs2(int i, int j) {
        Queue<Node> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Node cur = new Node(i, j, 0);
        q.add(cur);
        for (int k = 0; k < MAX; k++) {
            Arrays.fill(vis[k], 0);
        }
        vis[i][j] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            cur = q.poll();
            if (cur.d > t) break;
            if (dist1[cur.x][cur.y] < cur.d) continue;
            if (dist1[cur.x][cur.y] == cur.d && (g2[cur.x][cur.y]<'1' || g2[cur.x][cur.y]>'9')) continue;
            if (g2[cur.x][cur.y]>='1' && g2[cur.x][cur.y]<='9') {
                if (cur.x != i || cur.y != j)
                    add_edge(idx(i,j), idx(cur.x,cur.y)+n*n, INF);
                if (dist1[cur.x][cur.y] == cur.d) continue;
            }
            for (int k=0; k<4; ++k) {
                int nx = cur.x+dx[k], ny = cur.y+dy[k];
                if (valid(nx,ny) && g1[nx][ny]!='Y' && vis[nx][ny]==0) {
                    Node nxt = new Node(nx, ny, cur.d+1);
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    q.add(nxt);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line1 = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(line1[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(line1[1]);
        
        for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            g1[i] = (" " + s).toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            String s = br.readLine();
            g2[i] = (" " + s).toCharArray();
        }
        
        src = 0;
        dst = 2*n*n+1;
        for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                if (g1[i][j]>='1' && g1[i][j]<='9')
                    add_edge(src, idx(i,j), g1[i][j]-'0');
                if (g1[i][j]=='Z') { sx=i; sy=j; }
            }
        }
        for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i) {
            for (int j=1; j<=n; ++j) {
                add_edge(idx(i,j), idx(i,j)+n*n, INF);
                if (g2[i][j]>='1' && g2[i][j]<='9')
                    add_edge(idx(i,j)+n*n, dst, g2[i][j]-'0');
            }
        }
        bfs1();
        for (int i=1; i<=n; ++i)
            for (int j=1; j<=n; ++j)
                if (g1[i][j]>='1' && g1[i][j]<='9')
                    bfs2(i,j);
        System.out.println(max_flow());
    }
}
